dictionary.free_matrix_hint: The official OpenRouter catalog lists only models with zero input and output prices here. An OpenRouter key is required. Free limits can still vary.
dictionary.free_matrix_enable: Automatically use verified zero-cost models for selected tasks. If none are available, use local models only.
dictionary.free_matrix_empty: The catalog is empty or has not synced yet. Refresh it to view available models.
dictionary.free_matrix_live_idle: No free model has completed a request in this session.
